revenueSignal: Appointment-based clinics lose revenue when canceled slots are not recovered quickly.
buyer: Dental clinics, orthodontists, chiropractors, and appointment-based clinics
pain: Canceled appointments leave open slots, staff follow-up is inconsistent, and revenue leaks from the calendar.
offer: A cancellation recovery workflow that turns cancellation notes into priority, suggested rebooking windows, and follow-up messages.
growthChannel: Direct outreach to clinic owners with a before/after cancellation recovery demo
distributionNotes: Show one canceled appointment becoming a rebooking message and revenue recovery checklist.
whyItWorked: The buyer already feels the revenue loss from empty appointment slots, and the workflow is narrow enough to demonstrate with one realistic before/after example.
aiNativeRemake: An AI-native cancellation recovery assistant that ranks open slots, drafts patient follow-ups, and tracks rebooking attempts.
starterProduct: Paste cancellation reason and patient notes to generate a rebooking plan, SMS draft, call note, and priority score.
validationPlan48h: Create a 60-second demo, send it to 20 appointment-based clinics, ask for one anonymized cancellation scenario, and offer 3 paid beta setups.
xPost:
I studied this indie business pattern:

Canceled appointments are not just admin work. They are lost revenue.

Buyer: appointment-based clinics
Pain: open slots do not get recovered consistently
Offer: AI rebooking workflow

AI remake: cancellation recovery assistant
Smallest starter version: paste a cancellation note and get the follow-up plan.
shortScript:
Hook: Empty appointment slots are a revenue leak.
Context: clinics already know the pain.
Turn: the useful product is not a big CRM, it is one recovery workflow.
AI remake: cancellation recovery assistant.
Close: validate with one canceled appointment example.
imagePrompt: Dark SaaS dashboard for a clinic cancellation recovery assistant showing canceled appointments, priority scores, suggested rebooking windows, SMS follow-up drafts, and recovered revenue.
buildPrompt: Build a standalone web app for appointment-based clinics. The user pastes a cancellation reason and patient note. The app generates a priority score, suggested rebooking windows, an SMS follow-up draft, a phone call note, and a recovery checklist. Use mock data and local state only.
